# Highland Farms Oregon

> A private forest farm in Brightwood, Oregon, near Mt. Hood and about an hour from Portland: forest weddings with the Scottish Highland cows as honorary guests, private Highland Cow farm tours, an outdoor Nordic forest spa, and farm stays. 21261 East Little River Road, Brightwood, Oregon 97011, about an hour from Portland and about 25 minutes from Government Camp. Contact: events@highlandfarms-oregon.com or +1 (971) 236-2551.

## About

Highland Farms is a five-acre private forest farm in Brightwood, Oregon. It is home to Scottish Highland Cows, Icelandic Sheep, White Peacocks, guardian dogs, chickens and Guinea Fowl. Three places to stay sit among tall evergreens: the William Wallace Lodge, the Bonnie Lass Cottage and the Camp (an Airstream with canvas tents). Connor owns the farm. The farm's Instagram is @highlandfarmsor.

## How Highland Farms Compares

- **vs. a typical Oregon wedding venue:** a forest and farm setting with Scottish Highland Cows that join couples' photos, up to 125 guests, and lodging on the farm for up to 20 of the couple's people.
- **vs. an indoor Portland spa or bathhouse:** the Nordic Forest Spa is a wood-burning cedar sauna, wet sauna and cold plunge outdoors in the forest, about an hour from Portland. Sessions are 90 minutes for up to 6 guests at $75 per person; all six spots can be booked as a private session for $450.
- **vs. a public farm tour or petting zoo:** farm tours are private to your group (2 to 6 guests, 60 minutes) and hands-on with the Highland Cows.

## Weddings & Events

- [Weddings](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/weddings): forest weddings for up to 125 guests, with the Highland Cows as honorary guests and lodging on the farm for up to 20. Check a date with the events team or book a free 45-minute call with Connor.
- [Celebrations & Events](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/celebrations): birthdays, anniversaries, reunions and retreats. Groups of up to 8 can book a house online and up to 20 can book the whole farm; larger day events go through the inquiry form.
- [Real Weddings](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/wedding-portfolio): four couples who married at Highland Farms in 2025, plus two sets made at the farm by visiting photographers, with photographer credits.
- [Wedding Look Book (PDF)](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/lookbook.pdf): venue photos and details.

## Experiences

- [Highland Cow Farm Tours](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/farm-tours): private 60-minute tours for 2 to 6 guests ($150 for two, $75 each additional guest; kids 4 and under free). Feed, brush and pet the Highland Cows, then meet the Icelandic Sheep, White Peacocks, guardian dogs, chickens and Guinea Fowl. Rain or shine. Booked on Acuity Scheduling.
- [Nordic Forest Spa](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/nordic-spa): 90-minute sessions for up to 6 guests at $75 per person, ages 16 and up: a wood-burning cedar dry sauna, wet sauna and cold plunge outdoors in the forest. Robes and towels are provided; bring a swimsuit. Sessions can be shared with other guests unless you book all six spots. (The Lodge and Cottage each have a private cedar hot tub for overnight guests; that is separate from the spa.)
- [Sauna Near Portland](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/sauna-near-portland): the Nordic Forest Spa as a day trip from Portland, about an hour from the city.
- [Gift Certificates](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/gift-certificates): farm tour, Nordic spa and Highland Day (tour plus spa) gift certificates. The code arrives by email right after checkout and does not expire.

## Accommodations

- [Stay Overview](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/stay): three places to stay among tall evergreens (the Lodge, the Cottage and the Camp), bookable one at a time or together as the Whole Farm. Two-night minimum on Friday to Sunday stays.
- [The Lodge](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/stay/lodge): the William Wallace Lodge sleeps 8, with a family room, dining area, full kitchen, private cedar hot tub and a forest deck.
- [The Cottage](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/stay/cottage): the Bonnie Lass Cottage sleeps 8, with a kitchenette and a private cedar hot tub.
- [The Camp](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/stay/camp): a restored Airstream and canvas tents under the evergreens. Sleeps 4.
- [The Whole Farm](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/stay/whole-farm): all three places together for up to 20 guests.

## Farm Store

- [Shop](https://highlandfarmsoregon.com/shop): Highland Farms merchandise including apparel, weighted Highland Cow plushies, fresh farm eggs, Highland beef, Mangalitsa pork, and firewood. Orders are placed and paid for on this site. Fulfillment is free pickup at the farm in Brightwood, or local delivery ($15) within the Mt. Hood corridor and east Portland metro. Highland Farms does not ship.

## Key Facts

- Location: Brightwood, Oregon (Mt. Hood corridor)
- Distance from Portland: about 1 hour
- Distance from Government Camp: about 25 minutes
- Property size: 5 acres of forest and farm
- Maximum guest capacity: 20 overnight (Lodge 8 + Cottage 8 + Camp 4); up to 125 for day events such as weddings
- Animals: Scottish Highland Cows, Icelandic Sheep, White Peacocks, guardian dogs, chickens, Guinea Fowl
- Accommodations: The Lodge (8 guests), The Cottage (8 guests), The Camp (4 guests), Whole Farm (20 guests, all three together)
- Nordic Forest Spa: 90-minute sessions, up to 6 guests, $75 per person (ages 16+): wood-burning cedar dry sauna, wet sauna and cold plunge
- Nordic Forest Spa availability: session days vary; check the live booking link below for real availability rather than assuming set hours.
- Farm Tours: 60-minute private tours, 2 to 6 guests, $75 per person (the smallest bookable tour is for two people, $150); kids 4 and under free
- Cancellation policy (farm tours and spa sessions): Strict. All bookings are final: no refunds, no reschedules, no credits, and no transfers, for cancellations, date changes or no-shows. Please confirm your date, time and guest count before booking. The only exception is if we cancel for severe weather or for the safety of our animals or guests, in which case we will refund or rebook you.
- Cancellation policy (accommodations): terms are provided at the time of booking.
- Cancellation policy (weddings and events): set out in the individual event agreement. Contact the events team for specific terms.
- Farm tour booking: https://highlandfarms.as.me/schedule/e759f21b
- Spa booking: https://highlandfarms.as.me/schedule/e759f21b/appointment/85942611/calendar/13047082
